data.one_liner: Extracts waveform data from audio files for visual rendering.
data.what_it_does: Extracts waveform data from an audio file and provides it through a progress stream suitable for visually rendering waveform visualisations. It supports extracting multiple files simultaneously and running on Android, iOS, and macOS.
use_when: You need to visually render audio waveforms in your Flutter application.
You want to process audio file data into a custom .wave format for visualization.
avoid_when: You only need to play or record audio without extracting visual waveform data.
strengths: Provides a progress stream during extraction.
Cross-platform support for Android, iOS, and macOS.
weaknesses: Limited platform support strictly to Android, iOS, and macOS.
Minimal documentation provided outside of basic usage.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting min Flutter version to 3.27.0 or higher.
